args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Created from: Blue Sparrow Tech Hawaii Vacation Planning Document

Based on the comprehensive travel guide and itinerary created for the Blue Sparrow Tech team's company vacation, this packing list is tailored for the 5-day trip to Oahu, Maui, and Kauai.

**Essential Items:**

• Clothing:
  • Lightweight pants (3-4)
  • Short-sleeved shirts (6-7)
  • Long-sleeve shirts (2)
  • Swimwear (2-3)
  • Dressier outfit for dinner at Alan Wong's (1)
  • Undergarments and socks
  • Comfortable walking shoes
  • Sandals/flip-flops
  • Light jacket for cooler evenings

• Toiletries:
  • Toothbrush and toothpaste
  • Deodorant
  • Shampoo and conditioner
  • Body wash
  • Razor and shaving cream
  • Makeup and makeup remover (if applicable)
  • Hairbrush
  • Contact lenses and solution (if applicable)
  • Prescription medication and any necessary documentation

• Electronics:
  • Smartphone and charger
  • Laptop and charger (for work during downtime)
  • Camera and charger
  • Portable charger
  • Universal power adapter
  • Waterproof phone case

• Travel documents:
  • Passport
  • Driver's license
  • Travel itinerary
  • Travel insurance information
  • Hotel reservation
  • Rental car information (if applicable)
  • Hawaii state ID

• Miscellaneous:
  • Reusable water bottle
  • Beach towel
  • Snorkeling gear (if applicable)
  • Sunscreen
  • Sunglasses
  • Insect repellent
  • Collapsible umbrella
  • Power strip
  • Travel-size essentials (eye mask, earplugs, etc.)

• Food and drink:
  • Reusable coffee mug
  • Snacks (granola bars, trail mix, etc.)
  • Water bottle refillable at hotel
  • Collapsible cooler bag
  • Hawaiian coffee
  • Local specialties (pineapple, macadamia nuts, etc.)

**Regional-Specific Items:**

• For Oahu:
  • Waikiki Beach towel
  • Diamond Head hiking gear
  • Pearl Harbor memorial items

• For Maui:
  • Haleakala sunrise viewing gear
  • Road to Hana snacks
  • Snorkeling gear for Molokini Crater

• For Kauai:
  • Na Pali Coast hiking boots
  • Wailua River boat tour gear
  • Princeville Resort amenities

**Work-Related Items:**

• For remote work sessions:
  • Portable Wi-Fi hotspot
  • Noise-cancelling headphones
  • Laptop stand
  • Power bank
  • Business cards
  • Meeting materials

**Blue Sparrow Tech Team Specific:**

• Team-building activities:
  • Hawaiian leis
  • Luau attire
  • Team photo props

• Company branding:
  • Blue Sparrow Tech logo items
  • Team-branded water bottles

This comprehensive packing list ensures that all essential items for both leisure and work activities are covered, while also highlighting regional-specific items for each island to maximize the team's experience.
